name: Super-100 Programme - Uttarakhand
benefit: Under this programme, 100 Science students were prepared for engineering and medical entrance examinations in 2023–24. Faculty members were selected from reputed coaching institutes based on their interviews and experience.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a Class 12 Science stream student studying in Uttarakhand. 1. One top-performing student from each block, along with the highest-scoring students from the SC, ST, and OBC categories, will be considered eligible under this programme. 1. A total of 100 Class 12 Science stream students will be selected for the programme.
